description: This PHP file defines a class Smarty_Internal_Compile_Config_Load which compiles the {config load} tag in Smarty templates. It handles attribute validation, scope determination, and generates PHP code to load configuration files within Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Config_Load
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling the {config load} template tag in Smarty, allowing dynamic loading of configuration files with specific scope and attributes.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles PHP code for the {config load} tag, processing attributes and generating the code to load configuration files accordingly.
